info.comment: Flat vector food product: ledger apple. A simple geometric apple, cool red #C44B4B, navy leaf, sitting on a gray ledger-book shape. Corporate office aesthetic, clean geometric lines, no text, no faces, no photorealism, no gradients, no 3D, no neon, centered, crisp edges. Palette: navy #1B3A6B, blue #2F6FED, red apple, white, gray.
